Artists.Description:
SB19 is a multi-awarded five-member Filipino boy band from the Philippines formed in 2018. The group consists of Pablo, Josh, Stell, Ken, and Justin. They are regarded as a leading act in contemporary Pinoy pop (P-pop) and have made significant strides in the music industry.
SB19 was initially trained under ShowBT Philippines, a subsidiary of the Korean entertainment company ShowBT Group, but they are now in a self-managed group under 1Z Entertainment, a company built and managed by the members of SB19.

Members: John Paulo Nase, Josh Cullen Santos, Stellvester Ajero, Felip Jhon Suson, Justin De Dios.

BINI eight-member Filipino girl group from the Philippines formed in 2021 under ABS-CBN's Star Magic that was formed through the Star Hunt Academy program. The group consists of Aiah, Colet, Maloi, Gwen, Stacey, Mikha, Jhoanna, and Sheena. The group has garnered national recognition, dubbed the "Nation's Girl Group" due to their vibrant personalities and appeal to their audiences. Known for their vibrant pop sound and synchronized choreography, BINI has quickly gained popularity in the P-pop (Pinoy pop) scene.

Members: Jhoanna Christine Robles, Maraiah Queen Arceta, Nicolette Vergara, Mary Loi Yves Ricalde, Gweneth L. Apuli, Stacey Aubrey Sevilleja, Mikhaela Janna Lim, Sheena Mae Catacutan

The Cup of Joe Band is a dynamic Filipino musical group known for their eclectic blend of pop, rock, and acoustic music. Composed of talented musicians, the band captivates audiences with their energetic performances and soulful renditions of both original songs and covers. With a repertoire that spans various genres, from upbeat pop-rock anthems to heartfelt ballads, the Cup of Joe Band creates an immersive musical experience that resonates with listeners of all ages. Their infectious energy, versatile instrumentation, and engaging stage presence make them a favorite among music enthusiasts and event-goers alike.

This young pop/alternative band from Baguio consists of Gian Bernardino (vocals), Raphael Ridao (vocals), Gabriel Fernandez (lead guitar), CJ Fernandez (rhythm guitar), Raphael “Sevi” Severino (bass), and Xen Gareza (keys) that when combined together makes a great discography under Cup of Joe.

Juan Karlos "JK" Labajo is a Filipino actor, singer, songwriter, guitarist, and television personality. He is co-managed by ABS-CBN's Star Magic and MCA Music Inc. (Philippines). He rose to fame at the age of 13 from the first season of The Voice Kids. He is the frontman and primary songwriter of his namesake band Juan Karlos. He has since released two studio albums as a solo artist and two studio albums with his band.

Sarah Asher Tua Geronim is a Filipino singer and actress. Known for her musical versatility and performances. She is one of the top Filipino singers of her generation. She rose to popularity when she emerged as the winner of the television singing competition “Star for a Night”.

Among the most successful performers in the industry is Sarah Geronimo who is dubbed the “Popstar Royalty” of the country. She is also the most bankable.
